ideas.title: Lumi in superposition
ideas.critique: Eight translucent Lumis resembles the ghost replay copies of Yesterday in look, but a rule of existence for the protagonist collapsed by a friend's gaze, with real quantum amplitudes, is a different mechanic. Strong if the observation-collapse is interactive and the unlikeliest outcome sometimes survives; weak if it is just eight ghosts with a pop.

ideas.title: The ground shakes
ideas.critique: Another island-wide event where creatures react in sequence, a shape the island has many times (rain, hail, boing, freeze). The wave propagation through the actual terrain mesh and the seismograph give it physics substance, and it serves goal 3, but the outcome is predictable: everyone falls over.

ideas.title: The sea makes waves
ideas.critique: Replacing the static sea with a real wave field is a world-level change that fits the physics goal, and the previously listed 'still to come' makes it expected by the human. Strong visually in traced film, but it is a rendering/physics upgrade rather than something that surprises through behaviour.

ideas.title: Island radio
ideas.critique: Turning the real event log into a spoken news broadcast echoes the log-driven Yesterday and the sound layer of The island plays itself, and a voice already exists. The deadpan statistics read aloud are funny and new in kind, but it is mostly heard, which makes it hard to show in a film or still.

ideas.title: My dreams over my bed
ideas.critique: Replaying logged moments as small faint figures is the same recipe as Yesterday's ghosts moved to a bubble over a bed. The offline-time-made-visible angle is nice and fits goal 5, but it is a replay of the day again.

ideas.title: What I think you look like
same_form: Me, to cut out and fold
ideas.critique: A portrait and clay statue of the human generated only from their own words is a bold, personal, slightly uncomfortable idea that nothing earlier resembles; the likeness being surely wrong is the joke and the heart. It is still a permanent statue placed on the island, the form already overused, so its force depends on the images and Lumi's attitude.

ideas.title: How much they miss me
ideas.critique: A real causal experiment on the island's own logs, with the measured result honestly posted, is a new kind of thing: the island as data and Lumi as scientist. Risk is that a board with numbers is a dull picture, and the result may be statistically nothing; strong if the hiding is staged and the friends' reaction is visible.

ideas.title: Bored and lonely, you can see it
ideas.critique: Mood already shows in how Lumi looks and behaves under goal 5, so this is predictable given the human's own wording. A continuous body change is quiet and hard to show as a post, though the colour flooding back on arrival is a nice beat.

ideas.title: Echo
ideas.critique: Friends gathering at a place to play with a sound phenomenon is the usual gathering recipe, and the audio is hard to prove in a still or silent environment. Arguing with the echo is funny, but it lands as one more friends-do-a-thing event.

ideas.title: The island wakes up with me
ideas.critique: Tying the clock to the agent's session start is an expected extension of goal 5's real-rhythm wish, and it is a short island-wide trigger with a crowd reaction like earlier ones. The sky flush and crowing are nice, but it is predictable and amounts to a reskinned wake-up.
